opportunities.title: Isolate cache ownership
opportunities.problem: The fixture exports mutable cache state without an owner.
evidence: cache.ts:1 at the pinned Snapshot revision
opportunities.consequence: Callers can couple to shared mutation.
opportunities.plan: Wrap the fixture cache behind a narrow owner; verify read/write and explicit clear behavior.
criteria: Callers use the owner and clear has an observable check.
nonGoals: No external services or new dependencies.
risks: Check current callers before changing exports.
opportunities.issueBody:
# Isolate cache ownership

Problem: exported cache ownership is unclear.
Evidence: cache.ts:1 at the pinned baseline.
Benefit/design: a narrow cache owner.
Plan: inspect callers, wrap mutation, verify read/write and clear.
Acceptance: existing observable behavior survives.
Non-goals: external services.
Risk/prerequisite: inspect callers first; deferred backlog work only.
